assets.name: viola

assets.name: french-horn
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent orchestra instrument cutout for Felt & Fable Studio. Generate ONE French horn. The attached trumpet and tuba images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their golden-yellow soft fuzzy wool felt, fine visible fibers, handstitched edge seams, shallow padded craft construction, silver-gray felt metal details, warm soft light, and crisp silhouette. New subject is an accurate recognizable ORCHESTRAL FRENCH HORN, shown in clear side/three-quarter view: slender golden tubing wound into a large compact CIRCULAR coil with the tighter valve tubing and three rotary valve levers near its center, a narrow curved leadpipe ending in a small silver cup mouthpiece near the upper left, and a broad conical flared bell projecting to the right side. Bell opening visibly concave. Coils must remain round, not long U loops, with authentic open transparent spaces between tubes. No upright piston buttons like a trumpet, no vertical tuba silhouette, no saxophone shape, no fantasy hybrid. Whole horn alone fully in frame centered with margin. Materials should be realistic handcrafted felt, never glossy metal, plastic, varnish, or movie-style CGI. Native transparent alpha background including open spaces within tubing. No text, logo, label, ground, rectangular backing, stage, person, hands, stand, or drop shadow/glow outside the silhouette. High-quality detailed cutout.
assets.refinement: Refine this felt French horn cutout. Preserve its circular coils, three rotary levers, bell opening, golden wool felt colors, silver-gray felt details, fine fuzzy fibers, handstitched seams and handcrafted shallow padded aesthetic exactly. Correct the framing: whole horn approximately 14 percent smaller and centered with at least 6 percent completely transparent margin on every side; bell rim must be fully visible and uncut, not touch right edge. Also reduce the oversized silver mouthpiece at upper left to a realistic SMALL narrow horn mouthpiece on a slender leadpipe; mouthpiece outer diameter should be only about twice the adjacent tubing, not a second bell. Everything else stays the same. True native transparent background including inner coil gaps, no scene, rectangle, text, glow or shadows beyond the instrument silhouette.
